_comment: How each template sits in the world. Templates not listed use `default`. anchor 'surface': template layer `groundLayers` goes at the ground surface; the volume above is cleared (clear: true) and dirt is filled `foundationDepth` deep under it (foundation 'fill'), or each solid bottom-layer column continues down in `foundationBlock` until it meets ground (foundation 'columns', at most `foundationDepth`). `center`: template-local [x, z] that goes on the target X/Z (rotation none only; default is the footprint centre). anchor 'sea': template layer `waterline` goes at the top water layer (sea level - 1); nothing is cleared; ice in the keel (bottom 4 layers) is extended down to the sea floor when it is at most `groundDepth` blocks below, with `groundBlock`. `legacy_placed`: worlds made before the World Painter stored one flag per template, at this [x, z].
